    • bordered

      Optional bordered mode (text_field sprite background). Default true. Set false for borderless inline fields (e.g., chat-style).

    • editable

      public TextField.Builder editable(boolean editable)
      Optional read-only mode. Default true (editable). Set false for display-only fields where typing/paste/cut are suppressed but cursor/selection are still movable.

      Read-only vs. disabled (Phase 3b — Item 8). TextField uses editable(false) as its distinct READ-ONLY spelling — deliberately NOT unified with the disabledWhen knob the other builder widgets carry. They mean different things:

      • read-only (editable(false)): the field stays fully visible and the caret/selection are still movable; only modification (typing, paste, cut) is suppressed. Use for "you can read and copy this, but not change it."
      • disabled (the disabledWhen predicate on Slider/Dropdown/etc.): the control is greyed and wholly inert — no interaction at all.
      A consumer who wants the greyed-and-inert look gates the whole field's visibility (or wraps it) rather than reaching for a disabled flag; read-only is the semantically-correct primitive here, so the two are kept separate by design.

    • hint

      public TextField.Builder hint(net.minecraft.network.chat.Component hint)
      Optional placeholder text shown when the field is empty AND unfocused. Default: no hint.

    • filter

      public TextField.Builder filter(Predicate<String> filter)
      Optional input filter. Called BEFORE every value mutation; if the filter rejects the candidate value, the mutation is skipped. Default: pass-all.

    • onChange

      public TextField.Builder onChange(Consumer<String> onChange)
      Optional value-change callback (lens write). Fires on every mutation: typing, paste, delete, programmatic setValue. Default: no callback.

    • onSubmit

      public TextField.Builder onSubmit(Consumer<String> onSubmit)
      Optional submission callback. Fires when the player presses Enter while the field is focused. Default: no callback.

      public TextField build()

    • spec

      public ElementSpec spec()
      Layout terminal (Phase 3b — Item 6). Returns an ElementSpec for use in Row / Column. The spec's reported dimensions are the configured .size(w, h); the layout helper calls ElementSpec.at(int, int), which re-runs this builder's full configuration positioned at the computed coordinates.
